description: Answers the documents pin that this server does not give yet, and what it answers instead, grouped by what it lacks. The server's protocol run expects these answers in place of the documents', by exchange: a rejection replaced by its index, a member set by its JSON Pointer. SDKs read the documents alone. Deleting a group, once the server serves what it lacks, holds the server to the documents there.

experiments.description: The server rejects every exposure unknown_experiment until it serves experiments, so the exposures events-mixed.json expects rejected unit_type_mismatch and unknown_variation are refused as unknown_experiment.

protected environments.description: The server answers every environment unprotected until it serves protected environments, so the production environment the documents describe as protected is answered with protected false.
